about_the_game:
Set Adrift is a single-player exploration game set in a mysterious archipelago shrouded by mist. You begin shipwrecked on the edge of an unknown world. With only a small raft and a handful of supplies, you’ll fish for survival, sail between strange islands, and piece together fragments of a lost history.

The game focuses on discovery, eerie atmosphere, and environmental storytelling. Every island has been handcrafted, filled with hidden notes, odd characters, and strange landmarks. Some locations are abandoned, others inhabited by creatures with unclear intentions. Dialogue is nonlinear, quests are optional, and the world rewards curiosity over urgency.

Set Adrift invites you to drift, explore, and make sense of a fractured place where time feels off and the sky never quite looks right.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H2 (Build 19044)
  • Processor: Intel Core I6
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: No VR support
